{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Confirm the number of loyal customers
print("Number of loyal customers:", len(loyal_df))

# Confirm the number of converted orders among loyal customers
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
print("Converted orders among loyal customers:", converted_count)

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = converted_count / len(loyal_df)
print("Fraction converted:", fraction_converted)

# Output the final value
fraction_converted"}
